title: Human skin pores and micro-relief
purpose: Generate tileable PBR detail maps of human skin: pores of varied size, the polygonal furrow network stretched along tension lines, aged creases, melanin and redness variation, freckles and oily or dry roughness, in several skin tones. Use as tiling detail on characters, faces, hands and creature skin.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python skin_pores.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: pores
parameters.meaning: Pore grid cells across the tile (pore spacing).

parameters.name: pore_size
parameters.meaning: Pore radius as a share of the pore spacing.

parameters.name: furrows
parameters.meaning: Cells of the furrow network across the tile.

parameters.name: furrow_depth
parameters.meaning: Depth of the fine furrow network.

parameters.name: anisotropy
parameters.meaning: How much the furrow cells stretch across the tile (tension lines).

parameters.name: redness
parameters.meaning: Blotchy redness from blood near the surface.

parameters.name: oiliness
parameters.meaning: Patches of lower roughness, as oily skin shows.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Medium-toned facial skin: fine pores, a light furrow network, some redness.

presets.name: fair
presets.description: Fair facial skin with fine pores and soft redness.

presets.name: deep_tone
presets.description: Deep brown facial skin with fine pores and a soft sheen.

presets.name: back_medium
presets.description: Medium-toned back skin: larger, sparser pores, flatter furrows.

presets.name: aged
presets.description: Aged fair skin: deep furrows, creases and blotchy tone.

presets.name: freckled
presets.description: Fair freckled skin with light redness.

limits: This is tiling micro-detail, not a full skin material: there is no subsurface scattering, no colour map of a face or body, and no layout by region (nose, forehead, cheek). Pores sit on a jittered grid, furrows are borders of warped anisotropic cells and creases are ridged noise, all stylized approximations of real dermal structure. Skin tones are artistic presets, not measured; use the albedo as a tint or overlay over a character's own colour. Relief is small, so the normal map carries most of the effect. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Pits at jittered grid points with a 3 x 3 neighbour search
Anisotropic Worley cell borders for the furrow network
Domain warping of the furrow network
Low-frequency noise for melanin, redness and oily areas
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
